briefdescription.para: A short-circuiting expression for testing if a sub-expression is null, and yielding the non-null value if the sub-expression is not null.

detaileddescription.para: Experimental feature: Alternatively, this short-circuiting expression tests a "conditional" expression (one that yields both a Boolean and at least one additional value), and short-circuits iff that first Boolean value yielded is False, and otherwise yields the second value.
